__doc: Declared relationship between each bim-compiler build/erp/*.js module and the file that SHIPS at bim-ootb erp/*.js. Written 2026-09-02 (ERP_IDEMPIERE_UX_PARITY.md §IMPL-RESULT-F7) after a witness was found judging a drifted copy: W-MORDER-SAVE reported 4 FAILs that were purely the copy lacking hooks the shipped file has. Values: 'identical' = must stay byte-identical, drift is a FAIL. 'divergent' = the copy is deliberately a different shape (node/UMD harness vs browser); needs a stated reason, and check_erp_twins.js reports it every run so it can never be forgotten. 'unreviewed' = drifted today, nobody has yet decided which of the two it is — reported LOUDLY, does not fail the gate until classified. Never move a pair to 'divergent' to silence the gate; that is the one way this check can be defeated. 2026-09-02 §TWIN-CLASSIFIED: a pair whose COPY is AHEAD of origin/main (a forward-port pending a bim-ootb PR) stays 'unreviewed' with the branch named in 'why' — it is NOT 'divergent' (no harness/shape reason) and cannot be 'identical' until the merge; flip it the day the PR lands.
